The Value of Piped Water and Sewers: Evidence from 19th Century Chicago
abstract: We estimate the impact of piped water and sewers on property values in late 19th century Chicago. The cost of sewer construction depends sensitively on imperceptible variation in elevation, and such variation delays water and sewer service to part of the city. This delay provides quasi-random variation for causal estimates. We extrapolate ate estimates from our natural experiment to the area treated with water and sewer service during 1874-1880 using a new estimator. Water and sewer access increases property values by a factor of about 2.8.This suggests that benefits are large relative to the value of averted mortality, many other infrastructure projects, and construction costs.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了19世纪后期芝加哥自来水和下水道对房产价值的影响。下水道的建设成本对高程上难以察觉的变化高度敏感，这种变化延迟了城市部分地区的供水和排水服务。这一延迟为因果估计提供了准随机变异。我们利用一种新的估计量，将自然实验的估计结果外推至1874—1880年间接受供水和下水道服务的地区。自来水和下水道的接入使房产价值提高了约2.8倍。这表明，相对于避免死亡的价值、许多其他基础设施项目以及建设成本，其收益都是巨大的。

Equilibrium Particulate Exposure
abstract: We assemble global, spatially disaggregated panel data on ambient particulates, population, and economic activity, and develop a macroeconomic integrated assessment model of particulate exposure for 30 countries representing 60\% of world population. The data indicate the importance of country level factors in determining particulate exposure. Model results indicate the importance of equilibrium adjustments. For example, uncompensated oil taxes and agricultural burning restrictions may unintentionally raise exposure by shifting labor to dirtier sectors or locations. Model results also showcase the importance of country heterogeneity and fiscal management. Our results suggest that effective particulates policy requires accounting for general equilibrium responses. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 我们汇集了全球范围内、空间上分解的环境颗粒物、人口和经济活动面板数据，并为代表全球60%人口的30个国家构建了颗粒物暴露的宏观经济综合评估模型。数据表明，国家层面的因素在决定颗粒物暴露方面十分重要。模型结果表明，均衡调整的重要性。例如，未经补偿的石油税和农业焚烧限制，可能会通过将劳动力转移到更脏的部门或地点，而无意中提高暴露水平。模型结果还显示了国家异质性和财政管理的重要性。我们的结果表明，有效的颗粒物政策需要考虑一般均衡的反应。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Sewers and Urbanization in the Developing World
Subways and urban air pollution
abstract: We investigate the effect of subway system openings on urban air pollution. On average, particulate concentrations are unchanged by subway openings. For cities with higher initial pollution levels, subway openings reduce particulates by 4 percent in the area surrounding a city center. The effect decays with distance to city center and persists over the longest time horizon that we can measure with our data, about four years. For highly polluted cities, we estimate that a new subway system provides an external mortality benefit of about $1 billion per year. For less polluted cities, the effect is indistinguishable from zero. Back of the envelope cost estimates suggest that reduced mortality due to lower air pollution offsets a substantial share of the construction costs of subways. (JEL I12, L92, O13, O18, Q51, Q53, R41)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了地铁系统开通对城市空气污染的影响。平均而言，地铁开通并未改变颗粒物浓度。对于初始污染水平较高的城市，地铁开通使城市中心周边地区的颗粒物减少了4%。这一效应随距市中心的距离衰减，并且在我们数据所能衡量的最长时间跨度（约四年）内持续存在。对于污染严重的城市，我们估计一个新的地铁系统每年可带来约10亿美元的外部死亡率收益。对于污染较轻的城市，该效应与零没有显著差异。粗略的成本估算表明，空气污染降低所带来的死亡率下降，抵消了地铁建设成本的相当大一部分。（JEL I12, L92, O13, O18, Q51, Q53, R41）

venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: We investigate the effect of climate change on population growth in 18th and 19th century Iceland. We find that annual temperature changes help determine the population growth rate in pre-industrial Iceland: a year 1 degree Celsius cooler than average drives down population growth rates by 1.14%. We also find that 18th and 19th century Icelanders adapt to prolonged changes in climate after 20 years. These adaptations reduce the short run effect of annual change in temperature by about 60%. Finally, a 1 degree Celsius sustained decrease in temperature decreases the steady state population by 10% to 26%.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了气候变化对18至19世纪冰岛人口增长的影响。我们发现，年度气温变化有助于决定工业化前冰岛的人口增长率：比平均水平低1摄氏度的一年，会使人口增长率下降1.14%。我们还发现，18至19世纪的冰岛人在气候持续变化20年后会适应这一变化。这些适应措施使年度气温变化的短期效应减少了约60%。最后，气温持续下降1摄氏度，会使稳态人口减少10%至26%。

The fundamental law of road congestion: Evidence from the US
abstract: We investigate the effect of lane kilometers of roads on vehicle-kilometers traveled (VKT) in US cities. VKT increases proportionately to roadway lane kilometers for interstate highways and probably slightly less rapidly for other types of roads. The sources for this extra VKT are increases in driving by current residents, increases in commercial traffic, and migration. Increasing lane kilometers for one type of road diverts little traffic from other types of road. We find no evidence that the provision of public transportation affects VKT. We conclude that increased provision of roads or public transit is unlikely to relieve congestion. (JEL R41, R48)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了道路车道公里数对美国城市车辆行驶里程（VKT）的影响。对于州际公路而言，车辆行驶里程与道路车道公里数成比例增长；对于其他类型的道路，增长可能略慢。这些额外车辆行驶里程的来源包括：现有居民驾驶量的增加、商业交通量的增加以及人口迁入。增加某一类道路的车道公里数，几乎不会使其他类型道路的交通量分流。我们没有发现公共交通的供给会影响车辆行驶里程的证据。我们的结论是，增加道路或公共交通的供给不太可能缓解拥堵。（JEL R41, R48）
